title: Vice-President, PM and Council of Ministers
quote: All executive action of the Government of India is taken in the President's name (Art. 77)

boxes.title: Vice-President: office & election
items: **Art. 63**; modelled on **American** VP; ex-officio **RS Chairman** (**Art. 64**), casting vote only
Elected by ==**all MPs, elected and nominated**==; State legislatures **no role** (**Art. 66**)
Qualified for **Rajya Sabha**, **35** years; term **5 years** (Art. 67)
Removal: **RS resolution** by majority of all then members + LS agrees; **14** days' notice
Acting President (**Art. 65**): max **6 months**; draws President's salary

boxes.title: Oath, resignation, removal
head: Office
Oath by
Resigns to
Removal
rows: On PM's advice; loss of LS majority

boxes.title: Prime Minister
items: Appointed by President (**Art. 75(1)**); may be from **either House**
Non-member: must enter House within ==**six months**== (**Art. 75(5)**); **S.R. Chaudhuri (2001)**: no repeat appointment
Chairs **NITI Aayog**, National Development Council, Inter-State Council, National Disaster Management Authority

boxes.title: Articles → content
head: Article
Content
rows: CoM aids and advises; binding after one reconsideration

boxes.title: Size limit: 91st Amdt, 2003
items: Union **75(1A)**: max ==**15%** of Lok Sabha==, incl. PM (APPSC G2 2025) → cap **81**
**75(1B)**: disqualified defector cannot be minister till re-elected

levels.name: Cabinet Ministers
levels.note: Cabinet: **15–20**; word inserted in **352(3)** by **44th Amdt**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: VP elected by **both Houses only**; removal starts in ==**Rajya Sabha**==
President gets **no discretion** in National Emergency (PYQ)
**Dhankhar** resigned July **2025**: third mid-term VP vacancy
**130th Amdt Bill, 2025**: **30** days' detention → removed on **31st** day
AP: **P.V. Narasimha Rao** via **Nandyal** (**1991**); **Venkaiah Naidu** VP **2017-22**
